n: David asks God to hear his cry and pay attention to his prayer.
From far away and with a fainting heart, he asks to be led to a rock higher than himself — a place of safety he can’t climb to on his own. Many see Christ as that rock.

f.w: the rock that is higher than I
From the end of the earth
f.g: From far away — perhaps exile, or the edge of despair.

n: God has always been his shelter and a strong tower against enemies.
He longs to live in God’s tent forever and find refuge under his wings.
God has heard his vows and given him the inheritance promised to those who reverence God.
A prayer for the king: may his life be long, spanning many generations. Ultimately this finds fulfillment in Christ, the eternal King.
May the king reign in God’s presence forever, guarded by God’s loyal love and faithfulness.

f.g: God’s ḥesed and faithfulness, pictured as guardians.

n: Then David will sing praise forever and keep his vows day by day.
